summary: First full test pass on Travelo MVP. Backend: 23 pytest tests covering auth (login/register/me/profile), bookings (mock inventory: flight 6-9 results, train, hotel city-only, missing-origin 400), booking creation with server-computed amount + PNR, Stripe checkout URL creation + payment status polling, group trips (create, invite-linked notification for existing user, equal/custom/percentage split validation, balances suggestions + UPI deep link, remind → payment_due notification on debtor with upi_link in data, mark settled zeroes net, join by invite_code as new user), destinations (list=6, Goa detail with attractions/hubs/transport buckets buses/cabs/bike_rentals/car_rentals), chat SSE stream via Emergent Claude with persistence in /api/chat/history/general. Frontend: verified via Playwright — login → 'Welcome back, Aarav', booking search Mumbai→Goa returns 7 flight cards (Origin/Destination are Radix Selects, date is browser-native), select → passenger dialog → Pay with Stripe redirects to checkout.stripe.com URL, trip create with member (meera linked), add expense (3000 equal split), Balances tab shows 'Meera Nair owes Aarav Sharma ₹1,500', Mark settled → suggestions drop 1→0, notification bell shows 2 items, Explore→Goa hub shows Leaflet map and cab deeplink after switching transport tab, Chat widget geolocation deny → 'Best food in Goa?' returns streamed Claude response (~46 chars) within ~15s. All core critical flows are working. Network-level ConnectTimeout to preview ingress occurred intermittently on 2/23 tests during full run but every failure passed on immediate rerun (application-side is not the cause).

minor.issue: Preview ingress (journey-planner-5.internal.stage-preview.emergentagent.com:443) occasionally returns ConnectTimeout on ~5-10% of calls; not an application bug, all endpoints succeed on retry. Recommend infra retry/backoff.

issues: Date picker uses browser-native <input type=date> instead of shadcn Calendar/Popover per project convention. Origin/Destination Selects work but lack a text search — acceptable for MVP.

design_issues.screen: Dialogs (create trip, add expense, passenger, chat geo)
issues: React console warnings: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for {DialogContent}'. Add <DialogDescription/> or aria-describedby to shadcn Dialogs for a11y.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Replace native <input type=date> on BookingPage with shadcn Calendar/Popover to match project convention.
OPTIONAL: Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to all shadcn DialogContent instances to remove a11y warnings (AddExpense, CreateTrip, Passenger, Chat geo, etc.).

OPTIONAL: /api/payments/status returns payment_status='pending' before Stripe session is even touched; template response has 'unpaid' in Stripe's own status but our record stays 'pending' — consistent, just note this in docs.
critical_code_review_comments: routers_payments.create_session mutates the module-level `_tax_supported` flag on first InvalidRequestError; if the first request that hits the automatic_tax path succeeds but a later account temporarily fails, it disables tax globally. Consider per-request try/except with retry rather than a global latch.

routers_trips.build_splits: for split_type='equal', if the client sends splits_in with member_ids not in the trip, the code silently falls back to ALL trip members. That is convenient but could surprise callers — return 400 when any provided member_id is invalid, or document behaviour clearly.

auth.check_lockout uses `datetime.fromisoformat(rec['last_attempt'])` which will raise if `last_attempt` was stored via utcnow() as ISO string with timezone — currently works because utcnow() returns isoformat with tz, but any future change to storage type will silently break lockout. Add a defensive parse.
auth cookies use SameSite=none; Secure — correct for cross-site preview. Ensure production uses same or SameSite=Lax on same-origin.

server.py CORS uses allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True — Starlette permits this combo but browsers reject credentialed cross-origin with wildcard reflected origins in some cases. Consider restricting to explicit origins for production.

success_rate.backend: 100% (23/23 verified across runs; network flakes retried green)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (all requested flows: auth, book+stripe redirect, trip create+expense+balance+settle, notifications, Explore/Goa map + transport + cab deeplink, chat SSE)

The preview ingress has occasional 5-15s ConnectTimeouts — if a test fails with requests.exceptions.ConnectTimeout, retry it once before treating as a real failure. test_settle_zeros_balance depends on test_add_equal_expense running earlier in the same module-scoped trip; do not run it in isolation. rca_of_the_issue: No application-side defect. Two transient ConnectTimeouts to the preview host during the first parallel run created noise in the JUnit report; retries confirmed the endpoints are healthy. A single real test bug in my suite (email case-normalization in register assertion) was fixed by lowercasing the expected value.
